guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: adservice is the only service with a clear anomaly: adservice_error rose from 0 to 0.0139 and adservice_cpu rose 76% (z=+1.96), while all other top series show small changes (z<1.1). However, adservice does not appear in the service map or in any of the worst traces (which show error spans only in frontend), and there are no error or warning logs, so the link to the user-facing alert is weak.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect adservice for CPU saturation and its error source (check pod CPU throttling, recent deploys, and traffic). If throttled, raise its CPU limit or restart/scale out the adservice replicas; no data deletion is involved.
